sources.quote: We are utilising ElevenLabs’ text-to-speech tool, to generate some voice-over elements within Train Sim World 7. This is utilised in features such as training modules, as well as platform and onboard train announcements. All scripts and content are written by Dovetail Games staff, with ElevenLabs used to generate the audio in these instances.

HowMuchAI 按九个部件拆解本作披露的分析页，已读取原文；其依据仍是商店披露文本本身。
